verdict_summary: 3c DEAD/INSIDE NOISE FLOOR: train wants elim games down-weighted (w=0.7 edge) but that pick scores -0.54m on holdout (floor 1.773m); the prediction-layer shrink fits a_elim=-0.348 on train (elim matches less predictable) and lands -0.37m on holdout, inside the floor.
